The recent 15-minute window looks strong on the surface (440 buyers, 137 SOL bought, a 32% return), but 348 of those buyers have already sold, and sell SOL of 87 against buy SOL of 137 means the flow is turning. The 30-minute return of about 110% and the near-zero drawdown from the high suggest a price that has been held up rather than one that has absorbed selling. A position opened here would be buying into the window where a concentrated group is most likely to exit.

The name "Google Gemini" borrows a famous brand, which is a red flag for a memecoin rather than evidence of demand.

Round-trip costs of 1.4-5.1% on a $20 ticket would also be hard to recover from any modest pullback. Skipping this coin costs nothing. Recommendation: pass.
